v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/TL Layer
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Layer row of the timeline layer column. Size=Default: 28 pt row, 16 pt icons, 20 × 28 toggles. Size=Compact: height-economical row for Frame View ▸ Short (18 pt) and Compact (14 pt): 12 pt disclosure/type/editing icons, 20 pt-wide toggle columns (glyphs 12 pt, swatch 9 pt) so the header icons still line up, label NF2/Small 12 vertically centred; the frame grid uses the same row height and the NF2 glyph line (row bottom − 9).

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/TL Grid
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Empty-frame grid of one row: short frame ticks at the bottom (Flash style), every 5th frame shaded, row line at the bottom. Folder rows show a flat strip.

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/TL Span
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Frame span. Resize horizontally to frame count × 12 px. Static = frames holding content (grey), Classic / Shape tween = purple / green with arrow, Motion tween = blue (property keyframes as markers), Broken tween = dashed, Selected = frame selection.

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/TL Marker
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: One-frame marker placed at x = (frame − 1) × 12. Keyframe ●, Blank keyframe ○, Span end ▯, Property keyframe ◆ (motion tween), Action keyframe (a over ●). Use Tone = On Selection over selected frames.

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/TL Frame Label
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Frame label (red flag), comment (green //) or anchor on a keyframe; sits on top of the span that starts at that keyframe.

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/Tool Button
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Tool in the Tools panel: 32×32, 20 px monochrome icon. Flyout marks a tool group (long-press opens the group).

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/Color Well
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Stroke / fill colour target. Active = the target the colour mixer edits.

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/Icon Group
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Grouped icon buttons (align, distribute, transform, text align…). Swap nested icons; switch a nested item to Type=Selected for toggles.

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/Tools Panel
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Tools panel. 1 Column (docked rail): related tools grouped behind flyouts — Selection/Subselection, Free/Gradient transform, Rectangle/Oval, Pencil/Brush, Paint bucket/Ink bottle. 2 Columns (floating, Flash layout): every tool visible, plus View, Colors (fill/stroke, default, none, swap) and Options (snap, tool options). Icons are monochrome 20 px.

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/Stage Ruler
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Stage ruler in stage units at 75 % zoom. The “0” mark sits 375 px from the start (horizontal) / 225 px from the top (vertical): place the instance so 0 meets the stage origin. Drag out of a ruler to create a guide.

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/Guide
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Ruler guide. Resize along its axis to span the canvas. Selected shows the drag handle; Locked guides are dashed and cannot be moved.

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/Ease Graph
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Ease curve graph. Overshoot / Undershoot variants extend the Y axis to −30…130 % and tint the out-of-range bands; handles outside 0–100 % turn amber (back / anticipation easing).

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/Stepper Field
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Numeric field with ▲▼ steppers; drag the prefix to scrub, ↑/↓ steps, ⇧ = ×10. Layout: place with Fill width inside rows (never fixed widths in panels); min width 88 px; text truncates with “…”.

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/Line Style Select
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Layout: place with Fill width inside rows (never fixed widths in panels); min width 128 px; text truncates with “…”.

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/Breadcrumb Item
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Editing path: Scene ▸ symbol ▸ nested symbol. Click an item to go back up; the ▾ menu lists siblings (scenes / symbols) with search.

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/Registration Picker
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Compact 3×3 registration / transformation point picker (28 px). Click a dot; arrow keys move it.

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/Selection Box
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Object selection on stage: Group (thin), Symbol instance (registration + transformation point), Static text (round handle = auto width), Dynamic/input text (square handle = fixed size), Primitive (extra control points for angles / inner radius). Resize to the object bounds.

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/Transform Box
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Free transform: Scale mode (8 square handles; ⇧ keeps proportions, ⌥ from centre), Rotate and skew (round corner handles rotate, edge bars skew). White circle = transformation point.

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/Tool Flyout Item
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Row of a tool flyout (long-press or click the corner of a grouped tool). ■ marks the tool currently shown on the rail. Icon = 20 px tool icon, shortcut on the right; hover = bg/hover.

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/Brush Preset
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Brush library row: stroke preview (swap NF2 Brush/*), name, default size. Click to select, double-click to edit the brush.

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/Brush Shape
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Brush tip shape (Flash brush shapes): round, ovals, square, rectangles, slanted. Used in Properties — Brush tool.

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/Brush Cursor
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Brush / eraser footprint on the canvas at the current size and zoom: black + white double ring readable on any colour. Resize = ⌥⌘-drag (dashed ring + size chip). Eraser uses a square footprint for square shapes.

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/Shape Hint
v2 · System & Components (archive).shelf: Shelf / Timeline & canvas answers (R-006…R-010) · selection contrast
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Shape hint marker (shape tween, Modify ▸ Shape ▸ Add shape hint ⇧⌘H). 16 px disc, letter a–z (Inter Semi Bold 10), 1 px outline. Unplaced = red (not matched / not moved yet), Start = yellow (start keyframe, matched), End = green (end keyframe, matched). Colours are pinned to the Dark token mode in both themes (stage markers sit on artwork). Drag to place; hit radius 8 px; drag off the stage removes. Shown only on the shape-tween keyframes of the current layer while View ▸ Show shape hints (⌥⌘H) is on.

v2 · System & Components (archive).name: NF2/Motion Path Handle
v2 · System & Components (archive).shelf: Shelf / Timeline & canvas answers (R-006…R-010) · selection contrast
v2 · System & Components (archive).description: Bézier handle of a motion path ◆ key (R-008). Tangent line 1 pt color/guide from the ◆ to the handle; handle = 7 pt disc color/guide with 1 pt bg/canvas outline. Hover adds a 13 pt color/guide ring, Drag fills color/guide-selected. Hit radius 7 pt. Shown only for the selected ◆ key (both in/out handles) and its neighbours' facing handles. Drag = smooth (mirrored), ⌥-drag = break tangent (corner), ⌥-click the ◆ = toggle corner/smooth. Cursor arrow-reshape-curve on hover.

v2.25 · System & Components.name: NF2/Shape Hint
v2.25 · System & Components.shelf: Shelf / Timeline & canvas answers (R-006…R-010) · selection contrast
v2.25 · System & Components.description: Shape hint marker (shape tween, Modify ▸ Shape ▸ Add shape hint ⇧⌘H). 16 px disc, letter a–z (Inter Semi Bold 10), 1 px outline. Unplaced = red (not matched / not moved yet), Start = yellow (start keyframe, matched), End = green (end keyframe, matched). Colours are pinned to the Dark token mode in both themes (stage markers sit on artwork). Drag to place; hit radius 8 px; drag off the stage removes. Shown only on the shape-tween keyframes of the current layer while View ▸ Show shape hints (⌥⌘H) is on.

v2.25 · System & Components.name: NF2/Motion Path Handle
v2.25 · System & Components.shelf: Shelf / Timeline & canvas answers (R-006…R-010) · selection contrast
v2.25 · System & Components.description: Bézier handle of a motion path ◆ key (R-008). Tangent line 1 pt color/guide from the ◆ to the handle; handle = 7 pt disc color/guide with 1 pt bg/canvas outline. Hover adds a 13 pt color/guide ring, Drag fills color/guide-selected. Hit radius 7 pt. Shown only for the selected ◆ key (both in/out handles) and its neighbours' facing handles. Drag = smooth (mirrored), ⌥-drag = break tangent (corner), ⌥-click the ◆ = toggle corner/smooth. Cursor arrow-reshape-curve on hover.
